answer: In this PoA design, bonded escrows tie each identity’s stake to its signed actions, so splitting one operator across k coordinated identities does not dilute accountability: correlated equivocation triggers aggregate penalties scaling as O(k²). Upon detection, asymmetric capital depreciation applies an exponential multiplier to the swarm’s loss, rather than merely adding linear fines. A juniper, ember, or bridge label cannot sever the evidence linking coordinated identities to the same equivocation.
